clue.text: Cut the budget severely to pinch a penny — that'll make a big impression

definitions.note: a clause standing for the noun: a splash is something that makes a big impression

indicators.note: to pinch is to grip something tightly, so one piece holds the other inside it

blocks.note: to slash a budget is to cut it hard
p is the abbreviation for a penny

explanation.surface: A government's brutal spending cut, presented as a headline-grabbing move.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests pinching pennies as thrift; here the penny's letter is what gets pinched.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a splash is the idiom for causing a stir, so a splash is a striking, attention-getting display.

clue.text: Outward appearance of an expert on the board?

blocks.note: riding a board on waves is surfing
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: How a board member, or a chess master, looks from outside.
explanation.walkthrough: The board suggests a company or chessboard; it is a surfboard, so the expert is a surf ace.
explanation.definitionFit: The surface of something is its outside layer, how it seems at first glance.

clue.text: Telling falsehoods in bed?

blocks.note: first meaning: saying what is untrue
second meaning: stretched out horizontally

explanation.walkthrough: The surface hints at pillow talk; the two halves are two unrelated verbs spelt the same way.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is the present participle both of lie, to deceive, and of lie, to recline.

clue.text: Beloved soprano with small fashion accessory

blocks.note: s is the abbreviation for soprano in music
wee means small
a necktie is a fashion accessory

explanation.surface: A much-loved opera singer wears a tiny accessory.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweetie is an affectionate term for someone loved, a darling.

clue.text: Where dozens can be found with wounds or bruises

blocks.note: where something is found is the place it is in
a jury has twelve members, so juries are dozens of people

explanation.surface: A puzzle about where dozens of something turn up alongside wounds and bruises, like a casualty ward.
explanation.walkthrough: Dozens wants to be eggs or boxes; it is groups of twelve jurors.
explanation.definitionFit: Injuries is the general word covering bodily harm of any kind, of which wounds and bruises are examples.

clue.text: Grandma picking up two articles

indicators.note: in a down entry, picking up lifts the letters so they read from bottom to top

blocks.note: the indefinite article an, twice

explanation.surface: An elderly woman collects a couple of items.
explanation.walkthrough: Articles look like objects or newspaper pieces; they are the grammatical kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Nana is a familiar name for a grandmother.

clue.text: Vain American embraces tennis champion

indicators.note: to embrace is to hug, so the first piece wraps its arms around the second

blocks.note: US is short for American
Monica Seles won nine Grand Slam singles titles

explanation.surface: A conceited American hugs a tennis star.
explanation.walkthrough: Vain suggests conceit; here it is the in-vain sense of pointless.
explanation.definitionFit: A vain effort is a futile one, achieving nothing, so vain here means useless.

clue.text: I went over a little gimmick, without finishing a type of exercise

definitions.note: isometric is an adjective, here standing as a noun for the exercise kind

indicators.note: in a down entry, what goes over another piece is placed above it, so it comes first
not finishing means the last letter of the word is never reached

blocks.note: taken as written
some means a little
a trick is a gimmick

explanation.surface: Someone recounts reviewing a fitness gimmick and quitting before the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Isometric training tenses muscles against resistance without moving the joint, such as holding a plank.

clue.text: Heartless Eve, in ragged dress, gets mad

indicators.note: without a heart, the middle letter of the name drops out
something ragged is torn and messy, so these letters are jumbled
in places one piece inside the other

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written before its heart goes

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted Eve, wearing a tattered dress, flies into a rage.
explanation.definitionFit: To see red is the idiom for becoming suddenly furious.

clue.text: Cause trouble when discussing something that helped Charles get around?

indicators.note: discussing is talking, so the phrase is heard spoken rather than read

blocks.clueFragment: something that helped Charles get around
blocks.note: the blind singer Ray Charles walked with a white cane

explanation.surface: A troublemaker who brings up the walking aid of someone called Charles.
explanation.walkthrough: Charles is not a king or Darwin but Ray Charles, the blind soul singer; his first name gives the possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: Raise Cain is an American idiom for making a fuss or creating a disturbance, after the biblical murderer.

clue.text: Taking on giant alien holding up shell

indicators.note: alien means strange or foreign, so the word before it is made unfamiliar by rearranging
in a down entry, up means the piece reads from bottom to top
holding means grasping another piece inside

blocks.note: taken as written
a pod is the shell of peas or beans

explanation.surface: Fighting a huge extraterrestrial that is propping up a shell.
explanation.walkthrough: A giant alien reads as a big extraterrestrial; alien is the signal to rearrange giant.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt is to take up as one's own, as with a policy, a name or a child.

clue.text: Wear down the rodent's insides

indicators.note: insides are the innards, so the letters sit within the words in front of it

blocks.note: the letters run across the end of the first word and into the second

explanation.surface: Something grinds away at a rat's guts.
explanation.definitionFit: To erode is to wear away gradually, as water and wind do to rock.

clue.text: Tiny measure of anxiety from getting beheaded

indicators.note: losing the head means losing the first letter of the word in front

blocks.note: angst is a feeling of dread or anxiety
taken as written before losing its head

explanation.surface: A small amount of worry caused by being decapitated.
explanation.definitionFit: An angstrom is a unit of length of one ten-billionth of a metre, used for atoms and wavelengths.

clue.text: Space object sounds more substantial

indicators.note: sounds asks for what the next words are like when said out loud

blocks.note: something more substantial has more meat to it

explanation.surface: A thing in space seems to have more heft.
explanation.definitionFit: A meteor is a rock from space burning up as it enters the atmosphere, a shooting star.

clue.text: Inexperienced top to bottom? Time to hire again

indicators.note: in a down entry the top letter is moved to the bottom, rotating the word

blocks.note: green means new and inexperienced
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A boss asks whether a raw newcomer should be promoted and decides to rehire.
explanation.definitionFit: To engage someone is to employ them, so to engage them again is rehiring.

clue.text: Host ignoring the odds of team scheme

indicators.note: passing over the odd-numbered places leaves only the second, fourth and later even letters

blocks.note: the even letters of these two words

explanation.surface: A host who disregards the long odds facing a team's game plan.
explanation.walkthrough: The odds sounds like betting; it means the odd-numbered letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An emcee, from MC or master of ceremonies, is the presenter hosting a show or event.

clue.text: West Indian pasta, for example, including one legume

indicators.note: including means taking something into the inside of the first piece

blocks.note: pasta is a carbohydrate, a carb
I is the Roman numeral one
a bean is a legume

explanation.surface: An island dish of pasta with beans.
explanation.definitionFit: The West Indies are the islands of the Caribbean Sea, so West Indian and Caribbean are synonyms.

clue.text: Precious walk-around, indeed

indicators.note: around places one word on either side of the other, wrapping it

blocks.note: to tread is to walk
sure is an informal yes, indeed

explanation.surface: A sarcastic remark about a fancy little stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: Something treasured is held dear and valued highly, which is what precious means here.

clue.text: French guardsman's projectile: silver bread

blocks.note: a dart is a small thrown projectile
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
nan, or naan, is Indian flatbread

explanation.surface: A French soldier's weapon turns out to be silver bread, an odd thing to throw.
explanation.definitionFit: D'Artagnan is the hero of Dumas's The Three Musketeers, who joins the king's musketeer guard.

clue.text: Weakens insult about a stringed instrument

indicators.note: about means around, so the first piece surrounds the second

blocks.note: dis is American slang for an insult
the lute is a plucked stringed instrument

explanation.surface: An insult directed at a guitar-like instrument saps its power.
explanation.definitionFit: To dilute something is to thin or water it down, reducing its strength.

clue.text: In Florida, NASA zigzags with ancient inhabitants of the Southwest

indicators.note: in says the letters lie within the words that follow it

blocks.note: the letters span the end of the state, the agency and the start of the last word

explanation.surface: A space agency's rocket swerves over Florida, beside ancient peoples of the desert.
explanation.definitionFit: The Anasazi, or Ancestral Puebloans, were the prehistoric people of the American Four Corners region.

clue.text: Take place of Orange County dog

blocks.note: OC is the usual abbreviation for Orange County, California
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: A dog seizes a spot belonging to Orange County.
explanation.definitionFit: To occur is to happen, and a happening event is said to take place.

clue.text: Shockingly, Rove calls naked general

indicators.note: something done shockingly is done outrageously, out of its normal order
naked means stripped of clothing, so the outer letters of the word are removed

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written before being stripped

explanation.surface: Political strategist Karl Rove scandalously summons a nude army general.
explanation.walkthrough: General looks like a military rank; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Overall means taken as a whole, a broad, general view rather than particulars.

clue.text: Escalating charm sustains average love affair

indicators.note: in a down entry, escalating climbs upward, so the letters read from bottom to top
sustains means holds up, supporting another piece from within its arms

blocks.note: to enamor, the American spelling, is to charm
a C is an average school grade

explanation.surface: Mounting attraction keeps an ordinary affair going.
explanation.definitionFit: A romance is a love affair, a relationship of passion.

clue.text: Obnoxious kid from Southern California is the subject of experiments

blocks.note: LA, Los Angeles, stands for Southern California
a brat is a badly behaved child

explanation.surface: A horrible child from Los Angeles ends up as a guinea pig for science.
explanation.walkthrough: From means the kid comes out of LA, so LA comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: A lab rat is a rodent used in laboratory research, and by extension anyone used for testing.

clue.text: See a friend beginning to mount a fruit tree

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter, so only that is kept

blocks.note: to see someone is to date them
a pal is a friend
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Watch a friend start climbing up a fruit tree.
explanation.walkthrough: See looks like look at; it is the dating sense, as in seeing someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The date palm is the palm species grown for its sweet edible dates.

clue.text: British pop diva's first-class strike

blocks.note: A is the top grade, first-class
dele is the proofreader's mark meaning strike out

explanation.surface: A British singer lands a top-quality punch.
explanation.walkthrough: Strike looks like a blow or walkout; it is striking text out.
explanation.definitionFit: Adele is the London-born singer of Hello and Someone Like You.

clue.text: Starts to annotate clinical history: "Experiencing pain"

definitions.note: a participle phrase standing for the verb: to ache is to be in pain

indicators.note: starts are beginnings, so each word gives its opening letter

blocks.note: the opening letters of these three words

explanation.surface: A doctor's note in a medical file records that a patient is hurting.
explanation.definitionFit: To ache is to suffer a dull continuous pain.

clue.text: Letter from the professor's helper

blocks.note: taken as written
a TA, teaching assistant, helps a professor

explanation.surface: A note sent by a lecturer's assistant.
explanation.walkthrough: Letter seems to be correspondence; it is a Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is the eighth character of the Greek alphabet, used in maths for angles.

clue.text: Fire engulfs center of Odessa neighborhood belonging to a bygone emperor

indicators.note: to engulf is to swallow up, so the first piece closes around what follows
the center of a word is its middle, so only the middle letters are kept

blocks.note: to can is American slang for to fire from a job
the two middle letters of the six-letter city name
an area is a district or neighborhood

explanation.surface: A blaze sweeps through the heart of an Odessa district that once belonged to a long-dead emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: Fire looks like a blaze; it is dismissal, slangily canning.
explanation.definitionFit: Caesarean describes anything relating to the Caesars, the emperors of ancient Rome.

clue.text: Guard dispatched in a train

blocks.note: sent means dispatched
taken as written
an el is an elevated railway train, as in Chicago

explanation.surface: A security guard sent off on a train.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentinel is a soldier or watchman posted to keep guard.

clue.text: Where to keep a record of mischievous elves: Endor, at first

indicators.note: mischievous creatures cause havoc, so these letters are thrown into disorder
at first points to the opening letter of the word just before it

blocks.note: taken as written
the first letter of the forest moon's name

explanation.surface: Where to file the records of naughty elves on Endor, the forest moon of Star Wars.
explanation.walkthrough: Record looks like a register; it is a vinyl disc.
explanation.definitionFit: A vinyl LP is stored in a sleeve, the paper or card cover that protects it.
